_doc: Synthetic concurrency acceptance for parallel QA orchestration. Generated by qa/runner/parallel-acceptance.mjs. Synthetic only - no product surface, browser, or database touched.

checks.name: each worker has a distinct live PID
three worker processes genuinely overlap in wall-clock time
concurrency check can fail (serial execution would be detected)
each worker has an isolated result directory
only Director writes canonical QA files (no canonical file touched by a worker)
no product implementation code is changed by the platform
worker crash does not stop other workers
worker restart resumes from checkpoint / crashed worker releases leases
provider capacity block affects only that worker
conflicting results trigger independent control (no majority vote)
checks.detail: 2 PASS vs 1 FAIL -> CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE, not PASS

checks.name: supervisor restart reconstructs live/dead workers correctly
checks.detail: phantom RUNNING pid 999999 -> CRASHED, lease reaped

checks.name: parallel run produces identical or stronger truth than sequential
checks.detail: reconciliation is deterministic over the same evidence

checks.name: no production SQL is used by the orchestration platform
evidence guard can fail (PASS without evidence -> INVALID_TEST)
browser guard can fail (UI verdict without browser -> INVALID_TEST)
blocked guard can fail (BLOCKED without reason -> INVALID_TEST)
independence guard can fail (shared fixture across lanes refused)

_not_yet_proven: Browser-context isolation across parallel workers has NOT been proven. No storageState export exists, so isolated contexts cannot also be authenticated. Parallel BROWSER MUTATION stays BLOCKED until proven (lanes.mjs enforces this).
A real production campaign with 3 live workers has not yet been run. This harness proves the machinery, not the campaign.

real_campaign_pilot_2026_09_10.first_run_note: All three genuine Fable workers overlapped in wall-clock and each produced substantive evidence, then hit the 2 USD cap before writing RESULT.json. The pre-fix orchestrator labelled them CRASHED; that misclassification was found by this pilot and fixed (now CAPACITY_BLOCKED / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED).

checkpoint_resume_proof.note: Resumed from its own CHECKPOINT.json and EVIDENCE/, finalised RESULT.json without redoing the audit. Real-worker proof of acceptance criterion 8 and of the end-to-end evidence -> reconciler -> Director path.

real_campaign_pilot_2026_09_10.director_reconciliation: qa/BUG_QUEUE.json parallel_pilot_reconciliation_2026_09_10; every worker claim that changed canonical state was independently re-verified by the Director first.
real_campaign_pilot_2026_09_10.single_writer_held: git status after the pilot showed no canonical file modified by any worker; only qa/runs/** and the Director-authored changes.

classification: PARALLEL QA ORCHESTRATION VERIFIED (machinery) - BROWSER LANES BLOCKED PENDING ISOLATION PROOF

classification_basis.verified: criteria 1-15 pass on the synthetic harness; criteria 1,2,3,4,8,9,13,14 additionally demonstrated on real Fable workers in the C002 pilot (real overlap, distinct PIDs, isolated dirs, single writer, checkpoint resume, budget/capacity isolation, no SQL, no product code).
classification_basis.not_claimed: Parallel BROWSER QA is NOT verified. Criterion 6 is proven only in the negative direction (collisions are rejected and unproven isolation blocks browser scheduling). Positive proof requires an exported storageState that does not exist. Do not run unattended parallel browser mutation until it does.
classification_basis.honest_limits: Criterion 12 (parallel truth >= sequential) is demonstrated for read-only audit work only. Criterion 10 is demonstrated synthetically only - no real conflicting pair occurred in the pilot.
